title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode4 Driving Out Fear

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we'll be playing on the same stage as Saku and anemone again...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure why, but I feel a little nervous. Even though we just performed in a show with them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-Me too.
My heart's already starting to race...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It isn't just Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all nervous about having to play on the same stage as anemone.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Seeing how they're at a different level compared to us was an eye-opener. I get that. But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've gotta do this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we're not as good as them, and it's going to feel really uncomfortable trying to perform on the same stage because of what happened during our last show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But...
If we carry these feelings onto that stage, we probably won't be able to play in a way that moves that crowd.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we have to build up enough confidence for ourselves to overcome these feelings of doubt.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have to practice until we can firmly say, “anemone has nothing on us. Our song's gonna move the hearts of everyone in that crowd.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, that's what we've been doing this entire time, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree with Shiho...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're all practicing as hard as you can right now because you want to show everyone what your music is really about, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, isn't your goal as Leo/need to play music that moves people's hearts?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
If so...
That shouldn't change because of a band that you suddenly encountered. anemone, was it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
Right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're practicing because we want everyone who listens to our songs to be really moved by them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was sure that this song would really resonate with that crowd...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But being reminded of the way anemone played made me really scared... Because I know I'm nowhere near their level.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
But you're right, Shiho... We won't be able to play well at all if we let these feelings dominate us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, I'm going to keep practicing...
I want to put on a performance that I can feel proud of!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's the spirit! I'm sure you girls are gonna put on the perfect performance during your show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds kinda fake when you say it, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's not fake at all!
I'm sure of it because I've seen just how hard they've been practicing lately!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They've really been putting in the effort.
Ichi cut her finger after playing her guitar too much and I heard that Hona cracked one of her drumsticks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Hona, you cracked a drumstick?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd been using it for quite a long time... But I bought a replacement, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was worried for a second that you went a little overboard and became super buff!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-Buff?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In such a short period? That'd be really impressive...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Ichika, is your finger okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's okay.
Unfortunately, it's proof that I haven't developed thick enough calluses yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on, why are we only talking about Ichi and Hona...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've been practicing really hard too!
Like really super extra hard! Honest!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No one's doubting you there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly.
We don't all need red badges of courage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know! But...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, what if I jumped in by saying Saki made fairly quick work of what was giving her trouble?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Saki's been playing the piano since she was very little, and she seemed to be subconsciously trying to play the keyboard the same way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For example, when playing the piano, you want your tone to reflect how you're feeling. But you don't necessarily have to do that on the keyboard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And Saki's such a wonderful student.
She quickly realized how big a difference these little details can make, practiced as much as she could and overcame this challenge.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I got praised!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Good for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all working a lot harder than I expected... With no small amount of optimism.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(If we can keep this up...
I'm sure we'll be able to get through to that crowd.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And keep doing everything we can until our show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
We're gonna blow that crowd away during our next show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, shall we break into our practice groups?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Who gets to be with who today?
A few hours later
se_event_faith_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds a lot better.
What you're trying to express now is much clearer...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Looks like practicing these parts every day is really starting to pay off!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And I have you and the others to thank, Len! I'm finally getting the sort of sound I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, how many times do I have to tell you? Saki, you're able to play this well because you put in the work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate you saying that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No problem. And it's not just you. All of you have improved so much since I first heard you play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All of us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. We've all been trying our best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Len, it's nice to actually hear that! I sometimes get to hear everyone practicing while I get ready to leave, but it's kinda hard to tell how much we've improved.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means you must be really looking forward to playing together and seeing how much you've improved as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
But I'm also worried about not being as good as everyone else, so...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you wanna practice more... Right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You girls have all been saying the same thing. Almost as if you planned it beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's Leo/need for you!
Even when we're separated, we think as one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But try not to go overboard, okay...?
I know that band's been on your mind lately. anemone, right? I'd rather not see your hard work go to waste by you getting sick over them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
It's already pretty late, so I think I'll call it a day and get in a good night's rest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Mr. Len, thank you for today's lesson!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
I'll be looking forward to the next time I get assigned to you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Another hard day of practice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Hona!
Are you about to head home too?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki. Hello.
Yes, I am... But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You seem awfully sweaty.
Are you feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? No, I'm fine!
My body's just really warm after practicing all afternoon! If anything, I feel great lately!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear...
I suppose it's only natural to get sweaty after practicing for so long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This sound... Is Shiho playing her bass?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I think you're right...
But this is different from the way she played at the studio the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wanna go take a quick peek?
se_event_faith_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho's bass... It sounds so alive!
And really...
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fun...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's sooo cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes!
It's almost as if her bass is singing. I can't turn away...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She must've practiced so much until this point...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've gotta do our best to keep up with her!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
Getting to Shiho's level won't be easy, but let's do everything we can to make that happen...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All so we can play our new song in the best condition possible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do it!
se_event_faith_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Keep in mind what Miku said and...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Okay, that sounded pretty good.
But I still don't feel too great about the chorus after this part...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I have to keep practicing... A lot...
Until I feel absolutely confident about my ability to perform...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's still at it, even after practicing so much today...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes... I told her that she should call it a day, but she said that she wants to master the part that she's finally been able to wrap her mind around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope all the girls' hard work pays off in the end. Ichika included.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It will be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's stay faithful and keep watching over them.
se_event_faith_2022_003
